title: SREV-035 file api rename wire

audit_contract.description: API: File_Api_Rename / API_RENAME_FILE | wire: {"request": "API_RENAME_FILE_ARGS", "fields": [{"name": "file_handle", "type": "HANDLE"}, {"name": "target_dir", "type": "UNICODE_STRING64*", "unit": "bytes", "nul_terminated": false}, {"name": "target_name", "type": "UNICODE_STRING64*", "unit": "bytes", "nul_terminated": false}, {"name": "replace_if_exists", "type": "BOOLEAN"}]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: UNICODE_STRING64.Length is a byte count and must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
UNICODE_STRING64.Length must be nonzero, <= 32000, and <= MaximumLength
target_dir and target_name are counted strings; embedded NUL is invalid before C-string path APIs are used
target_name is copied into FILE_RENAME_INFORMATION as a simple relative file name and must not contain backslash
every malformed target path branch after path allocation frees the path buffer before returning
